items.title: Spider on a Silk Zipline
items.alt: One playful spider travels along a slanted silk thread between two short twig ends, two front legs grasping and six legs trailing separately.
items.description: One playful spider travels along a slanted silk thread between two short twig ends, two front legs grasping and six legs trailing separately. Useful for movement stories.

items.title: Black Orb Spider Web
items.alt: Black orb spider web with tapered radial spokes and open transparent spaces between curved rings.
items.description: A complete black orb web with clear open spaces and tapered strands. Useful for personal seasonal crafts and Halloween invitations.

items.title: Spider beside a Silk Egg Sac
items.alt: One gentle spider stands beside one rounded silk egg sac attached beneath a short twig, all eight legs visible.
items.description: One gentle spider stands beside one rounded silk egg sac attached beneath a short twig, all eight legs visible. Useful for family nature prompts.
